channel.coefficient_basis: Explicit synthetic SI verification scenario, not calibrated mantle parameters or a Gurnis input row.
channel.geometry: One-dimensional plane-parallel shear; fixed wall at s=0, traction at s=H, periodic tangential direction; no advective mass supply.
channel.temperature: Prescribed isothermal constant viscosity; thermal and plastic coupling are excluded from this analytical limit.

policy.basis: Predeclared numerical verification only: exact quadratic nodal solution; second-order variable-coefficient midpoint scheme and integrated power. No tolerance is inferred from an Atlas result.

acceptance_levels.i01: Select equations, inputs, support and test hierarchy; demonstrate bounded force-release/buoyancy/energy feasibility.
acceptance_levels.i07: Before generated initiation: shared objective elasto-visco-plastic kernel; resolved thermal/history/interface case; h/h2/h4 and independent timestep/rotated-domain checks; exterior sensitivity; reaction-work and finite-window gravity-supported continuation.
acceptance_levels.published_comparison: Optional external comparison once its source case is coherent. Missing Li-Gurnis inputfile.txt, morbphase.txt and rheology mapping do not block independent verification, and are never guessed.
